body.name: oracle-relative checkable global capacity certificate
body.construction:
Relative to a supplied oracle satisfying Definition \(\mathrm{interval\mbox{-}oracle}\),
\[
 \mathrm{Cert}=(\gamma_\epsilon,L_\epsilon,U_\epsilon,
 \{(I_r,\underline J_r,\overline J_r,m_r,\sigma_r)\}_{r=1}^R),
 \qquad \sigma_r\in\{\mathrm{active},\mathrm{pruned}\},
\]
is a finite rational dyadic certificate when each recorded oracle receipt encloses \(J\) on \(I_r\), every pruned interval satisfies \(\underline J_r>U_\epsilon\), the active intervals cover every global minimizer, the incumbent point receipt at \(\gamma_\epsilon\) has upper endpoint \(U_\epsilon\), and
\[
 L_\epsilon=\min_{r:\sigma_r=\mathrm{active}}\underline J_r,
 \qquad U_\epsilon-L_\epsilon\leq\epsilon.
\]
The certificate is checkable relative to the supplied receipt contract; it is not an unconditional claim that the oracle has been implemented.
